annotations.title: Cross-chain flows over time (net per network, routes, quarters, biggest shifts)

description: Where capital moved between chains over time, from ASPERN’s stored cross-chain indexes and the history counted before them (2026-11-25). Per network and month (or week): inflow, outflow and NET (in minus out, USD at the day’s price: Circle CCTP USDC times the day’s USDC price, par where none; bridges at DefiLlama’s price that day) and the cumulative net, on ONE shared scale; a period not read is null, never zero. Also the largest routes, per protocol (Circle CCTP V2 on 24 EVM networks, CCTP V1 on its 7, Across, LayerZero OFT, Stargate V2, Wormhole Token Bridge and NTT among Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and OP Mainnet), by quarter the links of where capital went, and `shifts`: the biggest net moves into or out of a network in a quarter with the main counterparty (e.g. +$X into Base in Q3 2026, most from Ethereum). `coverage`: the days read per network and protocol, the gaps, burns to domains not read, and that USDC via CCTP and four bridges are NOT all capital movement (exchanges, other bridges, OTC, chains not read are outside). `state`: read, not_yet_read or unavailable. Never claims the addresses share an owner, who moved it, that an AI agent acted, or that anything was autonomous. Per day of the last 30: cross_chain_stats, bridge_stats; one transfer: cross_chain_trace. FREE.
